_note: Canonical decision queue for the V2 planning layer (D-044). Status and ownership come from these fields only; PENDING_DECISIONS.md is generated from them. Accepted decisions also get a row in v2/DECISIONS.md.

records.title: Approve the nine V2 phase milestone target dates
records.required_action: Resolved by D-076: the owner approved the proposed dates for V2-M0..M5, M7 and M8 as written; V2-M6 stays on HOLD without a date. Whether they are planning targets or commitments was not stated, so they are recorded as planning dates only.

records.title: Define P6 LAB & ROBOT reopening criteria
records.required_action: Say who can reopen mechanical work, what safety and mechanical readiness evidence is required, and whether P7 and P8 physical acceptance depend on V2-M6.

records.title: Decide where Sim, SDK, Studio and Control Plane live
records.required_action: Resolved by D-144: SDK and Studio live in kritvaos-community; the Control Plane is a planned separate repository (kritva-control-plane, proposed name, not created); Sim placement stays open until COMMUNITY-004-01 defines the simulator artifact interface. No repository, pipeline entry, task move or baseline change is made.

records.title: Approve the repository and task ID registry
records.required_action: Resolved by D-080: the owner approved the repository and task ID registry in repo-pipeline.json as written (prefixes KOS-SENSE, KOS-MOTION, KOS-MIND, KOS-SKILL and the existing ones; task IDs are globally unique).

records.title: Approve the acceptance and test policy
records.required_action: Resolved by D-080: the owner approved the acceptance and test policy in v2/planning/ACCEPTANCE_STANDARD.md as written. No coverage threshold is set; one needs its own decision. Waivers are structured records approved by an authorized approver (approvals.json); the safety and security approval roles are the reviewer roles of D-047 (Dinesh, interim).

records.title: Approve the tag policy
records.required_action: Resolved by D-080: the owner approved the tag policy in section 5 of v2/planning/ACCEPTANCE_STANDARD.md as written (annotated SemVer tags; milestone prerelease tags only for an actual prerelease artifact). Who creates release tags is not named there: the owner runs `ship-prs.sh --tag`, and a different holder needs a new decision.

records.title: Approve the PR reviewer-role mapping
records.required_action: Resolved on an interim basis by D-047: Dinesh (dineshannayya) holds ARCHITECTURE_REVIEWER and SAFETY_REVIEWER. Name an independent holder when one exists.

records.title: Approve the status schema and record ownership
records.required_action: Resolved by D-116: decisions live in v2/planning/decisions.json, reviews in reviews.json, milestones in milestones.json, gate closures in v2/tracking/gate_closures.json, the append-only log in v2/DECISIONS.md; generated reports are v2/tracking/STATUS_VIEW.md, STATUS_DETAIL.md and consolidated_status.json; each repository reports in status/status.json (schema 2.0).

records.title: Include the four new repositories in the return-to-private plan and readiness checklist
records.required_action: Resolved by D-063: kritva-core, kritvaos-community, kritva-sense, kritva-motion, kritva-mind and kritva-skill are PUBLIC and stay public; the four capability repositories are not part of the return-to-private plan.

records.title: Choose the licence for the four new repositories
records.required_action: Resolved by D-064: Apache-2.0 is confirmed for the four repositories, core and community.

records.title: Register the four new repositories on their workstreams
records.required_action: Resolved by D-116: MIND and SKILL are registered on KritvaOS/kritva-mind and KritvaOS/kritva-skill (SENSE and MOTION already were), each repository publishes status/status.json (schema 2.0) with no baselined tasks, and both are listed in sources.json.

records.title: Approve drafting the Core engineering contract
records.required_action: Resolved by D-113: the owner approved drafting; the Core engineering contract is merged in kritva-core and pinned (commit 71a82e9b6e2ec3c6155270391adaa30e7751c1b9, SHA-256 b57e24ba9771b0d156a352ed88aeb0462123af3bf14e0b23b9ecb18a07127021) with a CI check.

records.title: Test the Community security mailbox
records.required_action: Waived by the owner (D-119): the mailbox test was not performed, KOS-COMMUNITY-M0-001 was removed from baseline v12, and security_policy is not moved to ATTESTED.

records.title: Make pr-acceptance-gate a required check in each repo ruleset
records.required_action: Accepted by D-061. The owner states that pr-acceptance-gate was added to the required status checks of the main ruleset in kritva-sense, kritva-motion, kritva-mind and kritva-skill (D-069; owner-attested, not verified from this repository). The gate stays report-only: REJECT blocks merge, NEEDS_HUMAN and APPROVE do not.

records.title: Roll out the commit standard (Conventional Commits and a Task footer) to the older repositories
Clarify Control Plane capability ownership, implementation responsibility and the planned repository location in D-144
records.required_action: Confirm during V2-M3 planning the repository location and ownership arrangement for the Control Plane. Working direction (D-148, provisional): RaaS owns the capability and its implementation responsibility, and the code is planned for the separate repository recorded in D-144. Before V2-M3 implementation planning, revisit the repository registration, ownership arrangements and dependencies; the Security Owner review of the authorisation boundary is a prerequisite for accepting the authorisation design (KOS-CONNECT-003 stage 2). D-144 is not superseded by this record.
records.source: Connect planning review, 2026-11-23; working direction recorded in D-148

records.title: Resolve ownership of the six D-109 Community SDK planning rows
records.required_action: Choose for the six approved D-109 planning rows owned by Community (PROPOSED-NEW-COMMUNITY-005-01, 005-02, 012-01, 012-02, 014-01, 014-02; 26 weight of 446): A, re-home them to kritva-sdk keeping their total weight, with the task and baseline changes approved separately; or B, keep them Community-owned with kritva-sdk tasks as unweighted support work and duplicate implementation and credit explicitly prevented. Until decided no weight, task ownership or credit changes, V2-M4 has no SDK repository milestone, and the CLI and job-run scope of these rows is not part of KOS-SDK-001 to KOS-SDK-009.
records.source: SDK repository plan registration, 2026-11-25 (advisory review with an external AI reviewer)

records.title: Approve a dependency-aware reforecast for V2-M1 and downstream phase milestones
records.required_action: Resolved by D-160: the owner chose option A (keep the existing intervals, V2-M1 slips 31 days): V2-M1 2026-12-31, V2-M2 2027-02-15, V2-M3 2027-04-15, V2-M4 2027-05-31, V2-M5 2027-07-16, V2-M7 2027-09-15, V2-M8 2027-10-14, with the program horizon extended to 2027-10-14. V2-M0 is unchanged and V2-M6 stays on HOLD without a date. The dates are planning dates, not capacity-derived and not commitments.
records.source: V2-M1 schedule withdrawal and dependency-aware reforecast required by D-159
